goal: Define the Apex Agent/Skill Registry v1 as an executor-neutral capability vocabulary consumable by Task Passports and future routing while preserving Apex ownership of task semantics, scheduling, authority, and verification.
scope: machine-readable canonical registry with stable agent and skill capability IDs
source mappings constrained by AC-DEV-011 Goose, AC-DEV-012 Freebuff, AC-DEV-013 comparison, and AC-DEV-014 extension audit evidence
claim-state semantics and Passport/future-routing consumption rules
Apex ownership and source-only boundaries for Goose, Freebuff, ECC, and future systems
out_of_scope: ECC installation, source import, dependency addition, or adoption
Goose, Freebuff, or other executor-specific integration
permanent executor selection or provider/model routing implementation
Apex Core Task, Attempt, authority, verification, or semantic-success redesign
elevating NOT_PROVEN, UNKNOWN, or PARTIAL mappings into runtime proof
architecture_constraints: Control Plane owns registry vocabulary, task requirements, scheduling, and routing policy
Apex Core owns runtime authority, verification, and semantic success
Goose, Freebuff, ECC, and future systems are capability sources only
PROVEN, PARTIAL, NOT_PROVEN, NOT_SUPPORTED, and UNKNOWN remain distinct
no ECC installation, no permanent executor, and no executor-specific integration
acceptance_criteria: stable capability IDs and source mappings are defined in a machine-readable registry
Task Passport and future-routing consumption rules are documented without copying executor identity into Core state
AC-DEV-011 through AC-DEV-014 evidence constrains every current mapping
unsupported and incomplete mappings remain NOT_PROVEN or UNKNOWN
Apex ownership of task semantics, scheduling, authority, and verification is explicit
the registry is reconciled into the canonical backlog without selecting an executor
validation: dependency and Passport review for AC-DEV-011 through AC-DEV-014
registry JSON schema and source/mapping consistency checks
canonical Python tests and documentation validation
git diff --check and protected PR CI gate
